subject: Vendor onboarding: provisional PO number and SKU line correction request
messages:
From: Elena Park <elena.park@greenharbor.co>
To: Logan Wright <logan@redwood.com>
Cc: supplyops@greenharbor.co
Date: Tue, 03 Nov 2026 15:12:00 -0800
Subject: Onboarding form + request for PO reference and spend cap

Hi Logan,

Thanks for the walkthrough earlier — attached is GreenHarbor's completed onboarding form (GH_onboarding_form.pdf). We are trying to align internal ledgers before our first invoice. Could you confirm whether Redwood will issue a provisional PO/reference number for the implementation phase and what the initial spend cap looks like for a pilot? We need the PO reference on our side to map invoices to your cost center.

Also, can you confirm the preferred SKU granularity on your invoices? Our system currently emits 6 SKU lines; if Redwood requires a consolidated line we can provide a v2 export.

Quick background: this will be a 3-month pilot for route-optimization inference (expected monthly spend ~$18k).

Thanks — attaching the onboarding PDF.

Best,
Elena Park
Head of Supply Ops, GreenHarbor Logistics
elena.park@greenharbor.co
+1 415-555-0123

Attachment: GH_onboarding_form.pdf (application/pdf, 232KB)

From: Logan Wright <logan@redwood.com>
To: Elena Park <elena.park@greenharbor.co>
Cc: Kimberly Park <kimberly@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 04 Nov 2026 09:08:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Onboarding form + request for PO reference and spend cap

Hi Elena — appreciate the quick turnaround and the completed form.

Short answers up front:
- We can issue a provisional PO/reference for pilot billing.
- Typical provisional spend cap for pilots is set at a monthly envelope; for a ~$18k/month estimate we usually set an initial cap at $20k to avoid early throttles.
- For invoices: Redwood prefers SKU line items to map to our internal product codes (we can accept the 6-line breakdown). If you want to consolidate, please flag which lines should be merged and include unit pricing.

Next steps I need from you:
1) Confirm you accept the provisional cap of $20,000/month for the pilot.
2) Send the SKU-level CSV (column: sku, description, unit_price, qty, gw_cost_code) so procurement can map lines to our ledger.

I've looped in Kimberly from procurement to provision the PO and confirm account coding. Kimberly — can you provision a provisional PO/ref and confirm the ledger mapping workflow? If easier, a provisional PO PDF is fine for now; we'll swap to a formal PO once legal signs SOW.

Thanks,
Logan Wright
Solutions Lead, Customer Onboarding — Redwood Inference
logan@redwood.com

Attachment: (none)

From: Kimberly Park <kimberly@redwood.com>
To: Logan Wright <logan@redwood.com>, Elena Park <elena.park@greenharbor.co>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 06 Nov 2026 11:35:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Onboarding form + request for PO reference and spend cap

Elena / Logan — thanks. Per Logan's note I created a provisional PO reference and uploaded the provisional PO PDF to the shared onboarding drive. See summary below and please incorporate the PO number on all first invoices.

Provisional PO: RDW-17892-PILOT
Initial monthly spend cap: $20,000 (will be monitored; please alert us if you exceed expected burn)
Account coding: 7050-ML-INF (we will reconcile to your sku -> gw_cost_code mapping)

Action items for GreenHarbor before we finalize ledger mapping:
- Please send a line-level CSV with unit prices (we need gw_cost_code column populated). If you cannot supply gw_cost_code, we will assign temporary mapping but will ask for a corrected file before final payment.
- There is a small discrepancy in the SKU export you mentioned: line SKU GH-RTE-04 currently maps to two internal descriptions on our side, which creates a double-count in the ledger unless split into GH-RTE-04A and GH-RTE-04B. Please provide a corrected SKU breakdown (we accept CSV or Excel).

Notes on invoices: attach the provisional PO PDF (RDW_provisional_PO_17892.pdf) on the invoice PDF page 1 and include line-level unit pricing. We will not process invoices missing the PO reference.

Marissa (finance) copied to confirm payment window and to flag if we need a contract amendment for spend cap changes.

Thanks,
Kimberly Park
Procurement Manager — Redwood Inference
kimberly@redwood.com

Attachment: RDW_provisional_PO_17892.pdf (application/pdf, 48KB)

From: Elena Park <elena.park@greenharbor.co>
To: Kimberly Park <kimberly@redwood.com>, Logan Wright <logan@redwood.com>
Cc: supplyops@greenharbor.co
Date: Sun, 07 Nov 2026 09:22:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Onboarding form + request for PO reference and spend cap

Thanks Kimberly — confirmed. We updated the SKU export to split GH-RTE-04 into GH-RTE-04A (edge-sensor preprocessing) and GH-RTE-04B (beam routing model inference), and included gw_cost_code values. Attached is GH_sku_breakdown_v2.csv.

We accept the $20k provisional cap for month 1. We'll include RDW-17892-PILOT on all invoices and attach the provisional PO PDF as requested.

We'll loop back if monthly burn varies materially; happy to set an automated alert if you prefer.

Elena

Attachment: GH_sku_breakdown_v2.csv (text/csv, 12KB)
